about: The club's history on /log, newest first. Commit messages are quoted as committed. Events in content/events/ are added to the log automatically.

entries.title: WesHack 2024
entries.body: The 2024 hackathon gets a repo in the Code-Wes org, pointing to its website.
entries.author: ananafrida

entries.title: The guide gets presented
entries.body: The club guide is updated before a presentation, and an officer is added the same day.
entries.author: danielgoldelman

entries.title: The site learns to deploy itself
entries.body: A workflow builds the homepage on every push to main.
entries.author: n-aggarwal

entries.title: The first homepage
entries.body: Pull request #1 brings the typed name line that still opens the home page.
entries.author: danielgoldelman

entries.title: A guide to the CS major
entries.body: The club writes down what it knows about Wesleyan's CS courses and faculty, from COMP 112 to the 300-level cores. It became the course map in Resources.
entries.author: n-aggarwal

entries.title: Code-Wes on GitHub
entries.body: The organization opens, and the website repo gets its first commit two days later.

entries.title: Initial commit
entries.body: The oldest trace of the club on GitHub: the start of the guide that became Code_Wes_Introduction.
entries.author: danielgoldelman
